text:
alice_sales: Heads up — biggest mid-market POC (Northpoint) is blocked. CTO asked for an exec-level unblock: SSO + KMS + formal pricing cadence. Can we triage? :pray:
ben_se: What specifically on SSO? OIDC metadata? Just need a redirect URI and cert?
alice_sales: They want corporate IdP (Okta) + SCIM for group sync. Also need an allowlist for service IPs.
claire_solutions: SCIM is on our roadmap, current supported flow is SAML/SCIM beta for Dedicated. For Hosted we can do Okta SAML SSO today.
dmitri_security: KMS ask — they want customer-managed keys (BYOK) for model input encryption. Our Private supports KMS; Hosted requires an approval flow. Need to escalate for SOC2 + KMS exception.
eden_account_exec: @frank_vp can we fast-track SOC2 artifact share and a KMS exception for Hosted? This deal moves fast if we can promise BYOK in test env.
frank_vp: I can sign off on an executive note to legal/security if we get a clear risk summary and mitigation plan. @dmitri_security prepare a short memo (bullet points) by EOD.
claire_solutions: For the POC acceptance criteria: 1) SSO with Okta working 2) demonstration of model latency at 95th perc < 120ms 3) data path diagram + KMS handshake demo 4) pricing TCV estimate for 3-month pilot.
alice_sales: Also pricing ask — they want committed throughput price vs on-demand. Need a short proposal.
grace_legal: For BYOK we need the contract addendum; Legal can't draft without security sign-off and model of key flow. I'll queue a quick addendum template.
dmitri_security: Drafting memo now: will include residual risk, compensating controls (no local logs, strict RBAC, audit logs to customer KMS), and recommended isolation (dedicated tenancy for pilot).
infra-bot: Deployment check: Dedicated pool capacity available in us-west-2 for pilot window (slot reserved for 3/30-4/29).
ben_se: On the SAML/SCIM front — quick workaround: enable SAML SSO + invite users manually to test groups. SCIM can be demoed via a scripted import during pilot if SCIM not ready.
eden_account_exec: Can we offer an interim concession: 10% pilot discount + committed capacity pricing if they sign the POC by next week?
frank_vp: Approve a one-time 10% pilot discount for 3 months. Finance will need the final quote. @alice_sales get me the estimated TCV.
alice_sales: Will pull numbers and send proposed quote today.
dmitri_security: Memo done, attaching in thread: https://redwood.internal/notes/NP-KMS-memo-6154321000 (internal). Key asks: legal addendum, temporary BYOK approval for pilot, dedicated logging stream to customer KMS.
grace_legal: Reviewed memo; will prep addendum draft by tomorrow morning. Also request: non-prod scope limited to test data only, no PHI.
claire_solutions: Action list: 1) SSO (SAML) config guide for Okta — I'll produce step-by-step 2) demo script for latency & throughput — ben 3) KMS handshake diagram — dmitri 4) Pricing draft — alice
ben_se: I'll script a SCIM import demo as fallback and document manual invite steps.
eden_account_exec: Customer expects an exec call Thursday at 10am PT with our CTO + their CTO. Can we confirm attendees?
frank_vp: I'll be on that call. Invite @cto_redwood? (we'll loop in product CTO if needed).
alice_sales: Scheduling invite now and sending prep pack once I have docs.
claire_solutions: Prep pack items: short runbook, sample Okta config, demo checklist, pilot SLA proposal. I'll draft first pass tonight.
frank_vp: Excellent. @everyone — please flag any issues you can't resolve by EOD so I can escalate to leadership call.
alice_sales: Thanks — will update thread as items complete. :thumbsup:
